description: 한국전력공사_데이터센터 전기공급 현황 [electricity and power and data centres] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 한국전력공사. 한국전력공사에서 공급하는 전국 데이터센터 전기공급 현황 데이터 입니다. 지역명, 고객호수, 계약전력(MW) 의 컬럼 구성으로 이루어져 있는 데이터 입니다. The portal shows 2025-07-14 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
